title: Floor Interior Design Rules
template: Modular Grid Room — 3x3 cells, manager-center, worker-perimeter

rules.managerZone: 1 center cell — manager desk + command panel
rules.workerCells: 8 perimeter cells — stations themed by floor department
rules.activityWall: 1 full wall = live data stream surface from /api/traders_live
rules.commandPanel: floating buttons above manager desk — actions vary by department
rules.backToTower: Escape key OR click button — camera animates zoom-out
rules.departmentTheming: color band + furniture set per department type

departmentVariations.command_kernel_model: terminal racks, server cabinets, big screens
departmentVariations.trading_research: multi-monitor desks, ticker tape, PnL boards
departmentVariations.worker_operations: workshop benches, tool walls, queue boards
departmentVariations.ledger_accounting: archive shelves, paper drifts, calculator desks
departmentVariations.maintenance: tool cages, pipes visible, gritty texture
departmentVariations.security_rules_inspection: cameras visible, OpenClaw bench, audit log wall

signoff: DeepSeek modular-grid pattern accepted; OpenAI generic template rejected as too vague
